series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): Rentarou visits a girlfriend's enormous family mansion and discovers the visit is actually a test: a hidden interrogation chair rises out of the floor and he is strapped in under a lie-detector lamp, where the first question is whether he really likes her. He answers honestly, she screams that he is lying, and the machine keeps judging him.
Prior events (Part 2): The interrogation grinds on and stops being funny. Cornered in the chair, Rentarou stops defending himself and starts pushing back, and later, on a dark swing set, the blonde girl admits she cannot keep waiting on him. Back in the mansion hall he makes a decision and bolts straight through her mother's security line.
Prior events (Part 3): The story drops into the memory the whole mansion standoff is built on: a crimson-haired girl in tears promising she will always stay with him. The promise does not hold. She breaks away, and the night ends with her on the ground and him left waiting at a door he is not allowed through.
